# GatherWell

> A green-and-cream portfolio demo of a church community workspace for pastors and community members.

Canonical: https://gatherwell-landing.vercel.app/

## Overview

GatherWell brings fictional people, groups, gatherings, communication, prayer, and care workflows together in a browser-based demonstration. Visitors can explore either experience without creating an account. Demo messages, giving, and assistant actions are simulated, and changes may reset.

## Demo experiences

- Member demo: https://gatherwell-demo.vercel.app/member-login
- Pastor demo: https://gatherwell-demo.vercel.app/pastor-login
